units.description: Apply SOC Investigator triage procedures to the ingested alert: filter out false positives, identify potential indicators of compromise (IOCs), and gather supporting evidence from logs, endpoint telemetry, or network captures. Correlate with known threat intelligence where possible.

units.task_name: MITRE ATT&CK Mapping and Attack Chain Reconstruction
units.description: Map the collected IOCs and observed behaviors to MITRE ATT&CK techniques. Construct a high‑level attack chain diagram that shows the adversary’s progression from initial compromise through lateral movement, persistence, and exfiltration (if applicable).

units.task_name: Impact Scope Analysis and Containment Recommendations
units.description: Determine the extent of compromise by identifying affected hosts, compromised accounts, data exfiltrated, or services disrupted. Provide containment actions (e.g., isolate hosts, revoke credentials) and a prioritized remediation plan.

units.task_name: Final Verification Report and Executive Summary
units.description: Compile all findings into a single, structured report: alert validity verdict, attack chain narrative, MITRE mapping, impact assessment, containment actions, and lessons learned. Include an executive summary suitable for non‑technical stakeholders.

dag.goal: Develop a structured analytical workflow to determine whether a given security alert represents an actual attack, reconstruct the sequence of events that occurred, and trace the extent of impact across the environment.
dag.reasoning: The user requests a comprehensive verification process for a security alert. This requires multiple distinct phases: ingesting alert data, performing triage and evidence collection, mapping adversary behavior to MITRE ATT&CK, building a timeline, assessing scope, and producing an actionable report. Each phase is independent enough to be executed as a separate task but must depend on the outputs of preceding steps. The SOC Investigator skill set covers all necessary capabilities (triage, evidence gathering, MITRE mapping, timeline synthesis, containment recommendations).

tasks.name: Ingest Alert and Initial Contextualization
tasks.description: Collect the raw alert payload (e.g., SIEM event, IDS log, or user‑reported incident) and any associated metadata such as source IPs, timestamps, affected hosts, and severity. Normalize the data into a structured format suitable for downstream analysis.
tasks.expected_output: A clean, tabular representation of the alert with key fields (timestamp, source, destination, event type, severity) ready for triage.

tasks.name: Triage and Evidence Collection
tasks.description: Apply SOC Investigator triage procedures to the ingested alert: filter out false positives, identify potential indicators of compromise (IOCs), and gather supporting evidence from logs, endpoint telemetry, or network captures. Correlate with known threat intelligence where possible.
tasks.expected_output: A list of confirmed IOCs, correlated log entries, and a preliminary assessment of alert validity (likely malicious / benign).

tasks.name: MITRE ATT&CK Mapping and Attack Chain Reconstruction
tasks.description: Map the collected IOCs and observed behaviors to MITRE ATT&CK techniques. Construct a high‑level attack chain diagram that shows the adversary’s progression from initial compromise through lateral movement, persistence, and exfiltration (if applicable).
tasks.expected_output: A structured mapping of techniques used, with a narrative describing each step in the attack chain.

tasks.name: Impact Scope Analysis and Containment Recommendations
tasks.description: Determine the extent of compromise by identifying affected hosts, compromised accounts, data exfiltrated, or services disrupted. Provide containment actions (e.g., isolate hosts, revoke credentials) and a prioritized remediation plan.
tasks.expected_output: A concise impact report with affected asset list, risk rating, and step‑by‑step containment guidance.

tasks.name: Final Verification Report and Executive Summary
tasks.description: Compile all findings into a single, structured report: alert validity verdict, attack chain narrative, MITRE mapping, impact assessment, containment actions, and lessons learned. Include an executive summary suitable for non‑technical stakeholders.
tasks.expected_output: A polished, multi‑section document (or markdown) summarizing the entire investigation.
